title: Meeting
description: One meeting (EE-200), at operations/meetings/<id>.json (route operations/meeting/[id]): a goal, the outcome that shows it was reached, who attends (people and agents), an agenda worked in order, the minutes, the outcome and what each attendee takes away. A meeting may walk a function workflow (`workflow`), with one agenda item per step. It follows the practice that a meeting states its purpose and desired outcome before it starts and ends with decisions and owned actions recorded (Lencioni, Death by Meeting, 2004; Rogelberg, The Surprising Science of Meetings, 2019). Status: planned, then open, then closed or abandoned. A closed meeting has its outcome and the time it closed, and no agenda item is still pending. Closed meetings are what agents read as shared memory: an app derives each attendee's memory from them, and nothing copies a meeting into a second record. A meeting spans functions, so the type names none (function null); the gate and the team plan decide who writes it.

goal.description: What the meeting must achieve, in one sentence, stated before it opens

outcome_expected.description: What exists when the meeting has done its job: records written, decisions raised, an answer. Read at close to say whether the goal was reached

workflow.description: The function workflow this meeting walks, `<function>/<workflow>`. Its steps become agenda items, in order

called_by.description: Who called it: a person's id or a team-plan role id

facilitator.description: Who runs the agenda, a person's id or a role id. Defaults to called_by

id.description: A person's id or a team-plan role id (strategy-agent)

status.description: planned: called, not started. open: the agenda is being worked. closed: ended with an outcome. abandoned: ended without one

step.description: The workflow step this item works, when the meeting walks a workflow

owner.description: Who answers for the item, a person's id or a role id

ask.description: True when the item needs a person's answer before it is done

status.description: pending: not yet worked. done: worked. skipped: passed over for now, to loop back to. handed-off: given to an agent or a person to recommend or finish, named in handed_to

result.description: What came of it, in a sentence

writes.description: Routes written or drafted while working it

decisions.description: Decision ids raised or settled while working it

handed_to.description: Who the item was handed to, for handed-off

recommendation.description: What the agent it was handed to recommends

item.description: The agenda item id this note is about

follow_up.description: What happens next, and who starts it

text.description: What this attendee should remember from the meeting

takeaways.description: What each attendee takes away. An app gives an agent its own takeaways, and the outcomes of every closed meeting, as memory

tool.description: What recorded the meeting: the agent run, or a meeting tool the business uses

transcript.description: Where the transcript is kept, a path or route in the business

recording.description: How the meeting was recorded, so that agents can see what was said
